title: I've added phased bosses to Mote and the Shattered Prism
author: yuhboimarc
selftext: Utilized Fable and Opus 5.5 to build this game from scratch with Claude Code. No other external tools were utilized.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/yuhboimarc please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Saying you used AI isn't enough on its own. We're looking for the actual dev details. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with low quality game posts. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.

replies.author: Electronic-Movie4208
replies.body: I understand wanting to maintain quality posts, but I think this is a little harsh. The developer did explain which AI tools they used and their general workflow. Maybe they could add more technical details, but I wouldn't consider this a low quality post.

comments.author: Electronic-Movie4208
comments.body: 24 bosses and one tiny blob? Love the concept! The pixel art looks great too. Pretty impressive that you built this using just Claude Code. I'm working on my own RPG with AI, so it's always cool seeing what other developers are creating. Is there a playable demo yet?

replies.author: yuhboimarc
replies.body:
I really appreciate that 😭 There will be a demo, but I want to make sure I make some tweaks first so it's a fun and playable demo for everyone! It's close.

Btw this video is to illustrate the different forms, so boss health will definitely not go down that quickly - they are pretty challenging!

https://reddit.com/link/1xyqu4s/video/n2xyekaxu72i1/player

replies.author: Electronic-Movie4208
replies.body:
That's awesome, man! Take your time, quality matters! I'd love to try the demo when it's ready. Feel free to follow me and I'll follow you back. Always happy to support fellow indie developers and see their projects grow!

https://solacekingdom.pages.dev/play/solace

replies.author: yuhboimarc
replies.body: No doubt, I just gave your game a try. I think it's a cool concept but I would deffffinitely work on the UI as it looks a bit robotic - and maybe make it just a little bit more challenging in the first fight. Overall, I love a good turn-based RPG so never give up bro and keep at it 💪

replies.author: Electronic-Movie4208
replies.body: Thanks so much for actually playing it, man! I really appreciate the honest feedback. I'll definitely work on making the UI feel more natural and improving the difficulty of the first fight. This is exactly the kind of feedback I need to make Lanternwake better. Thanks for the encouragement, bro!
